1672 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not a century year).  
09-09-1672 minus 249 days:  
First, go back 9 days to 1672-08-31.  
Remaining 240 days: back 31 days to 1672-07-31, then back 30 days to 1672-06-01, then back 31 days to 1672-05-01, then back 30 days to 1672-04-01, then back 31 days to 1672-03-01, then back 29 days (Feb in leap year) to 1672-02-01, then back 31 days to 1673-01-01? Wait — that’s forward. Let’s compute systematically:  

From 1672-09-09:  
Subtract 9 days → 1672-08-31.  
Subtract 31 days → 1672-07-31.  
Subtract 30 days → 1672-07-01.  
Subtract 31 days → 1672-05-31.  
Subtract 30 days → 1672-05-01.  
Subtract 31 days → 1672-03-31.  
Subtract 30 days → 1672-03-01.  
Subtract 29 days (Feb leap year) → 1672-02-01.  
Subtract 31 days → 1672-01-01.  

Sum of subtracted days so far: 9+31+30+31+30+31+30+29+31 = 242 days. Need 249 total, so 7 more days back from 1672-01-01 → 1671-12-25.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1671-12-25
